mapper.sql: tenant_id AS tenantId, environment_name AS environment, cell_id AS cell, namespace_name AS namespace, campaign_id AS campaignId, probe_id AS probeId, destination_topic AS destinationTopic, total_routes AS totalRoutes, next_nonce AS nextNonce, delivery_state AS deliveryState, failure_count AS failureCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, lease_owner AS leaseOwner, lease_epoch AS leaseEpoch, lease_until AS leaseUntil, last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_journey_probe_delivery (tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, namespace_name, campaign_id, probe_id, destination_topic, total_routes, next_nonce, delivery_state, failure_count, next_attempt_at, expires_at, lease_owner, lease_epoch, lease_until, last_error_code, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{key.tenantId}, #{key.environment}, #{key.cell}, #{key.namespace}, #{key.campaignId}, #{key.probeId}, #{value.destinationTopic}, #{value.totalRoutes}, 0, 'QUEUED', 0, #{value.nextAttemptAt}, #{value.expiresAt}, NULL, 0, NULL, '', #{value.createdBy}, #{value.createdAt}, #{value.createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE probe_id = mk_journey_probe_delivery.probe_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mk_journey_probe_delivery WHERE tenant_id = #{key.tenantId} AND environment_name = #{key.environment} AND cell_id = #{key.cell} AND namespace_name = #{key.namespace} AND campaign_id = #{key.campaignId} AND probe_id = #{key.probeId}

SELECT FROM mk_journey_probe_delivery FORCE INDEX (idx_probe_delivery_due) WHERE environment_name = #{slot.environment} AND cell_id = #{slot.cell} AND namespace_name = #{slot.namespace} AND pending = TRUE AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND expires_at > #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
